title: Linear Separability
body: Suppose we fit a logistic regression model with two features $$x_1$$ and $$x_2$$ and find that with classification threshold $$T=0.75$$ and $$\hat{\beta}=(\hat{\beta}_1,\hat{\beta}_2)=(2,3)$$ we achieve 100% training accuracy.\nLet $$x_2=mx_1+b$$ be the equation for the line that separates the two classes. Give $$m$$ and $$b$$ (you may leave your answers in terms of log). Hint: You might find the following fact useful:\n$$\sigma(\log(3))=0.75$$
